name: Zierteich Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Zierteich Imbiss in Tirol!**

Indulge in authentic Tyrolean flavors at our cozy outdoor spot near **Innsbruck**. Savor our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy on the outside and tender inside, served with fresh fruit compote or a drizzle of vanilla sauce. Pair it with a frothy **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** for the perfect alpine experience.

Try our hearty **Kaspressknödel**—creamy cheese dumplings smothered in rich gravy—or dig into a juicy **Schweinsbraten** with **Semmelknödel** and **Krautsalat**. For a lighter bite, our **Leberkäse** sandwiches are a local favorite, served with tangy mustard and pickles.

Freshly baked **Brezen** and **Kipferl** round out your meal, while our homemade **Kaffee** and **Eis** (vanilla, strawberry, or **Tiroler Bergkäse**—yes, cheese ice cream!) complete your visit.

**Zierteich Imbiss**—where tradition meets the great outdoors in the heart of **Tirol**!
